educational_overlay.purpose: Comprehensive structural audit of Master Services Agreements (MSAs) and vendor contracts against company playbooks.
educational_overlay.when_to_use: When reviewing inbound supplier contracts for enterprise IT, marketing, or logistics engagements.
educational_overlay.when_not_to_use: For consumer standard terms of service or pure employment contracts.
educational_overlay.prompt_template:
Act as commercial counsel reviewing an MSA on behalf of {{PARTY_SIDE}}.
Assess liability cap benchmarked at {{LIABILITY_CAP}} and evaluate data security provisions against {{DATA_SECURITY_STANDARD}}.
Identify uncapped liabilities, termination rights, payment terms, and warranty disclaimers.
Provide clause-by-clause fallback suggestions for contested provisions.
Mark unverified assumptions with [VERIFY].
educational_overlay.fictional_scenario: FinTech Corp is onboarding Enterprise Cloud Services for payment gateway hosting with an annual contract value of Rs. 40,00,000.
educational_overlay.sample_output:
### Vendor Agreement Review Matrix
- **Liability (Section 8)**: Vendor caps total liability to fees paid in last 1 month. [FALLBACK: 12 months fees paid or Rs. 50 Lakhs].
- **Warranty (Section 6)**: Vendor disclaims all implied warranties of merchantability and fitness.
guardrails: Confirm liability cap carve-outs include confidentiality breach and data privacy violations.
verification_checklist: Check limitation period under Limitation Act 1963.
Verify SLA credit mechanisms are realistic.
educational_overlay.ai_risk_warning: Verify pricing tiers and tax calculations with internal finance.
